nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): computes c = a + b and requires c >= a.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): requires b <= a then computes c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): computes c = a * b and requires a == 0 || c / a == b.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): requires b > 0 then computes c = a / b.
Owned.owner: address holding owner privileges, set to msg.sender in constructor and mutable via transferOwnership/acceptOwnership.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) protected by onlyOwner; sets owner = _newOwner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, then owner = newOwner and newOwner = address(0).
ContractDeployer.symbol token ticker.
ContractDeployer.name token name.
ContractDeployer.decimals token decimals, used as exponent when scaling total supply.
ContractDeployer._totalSupply: total token supply computed in the constructor.
ContractDeployer.balances: mapping(address => uint) of account balances.
ContractDeployer.allowed: mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances.
ContractDeployer constructor(string _symbol, string _name, uint8 _decimals, uint totalSupply, address _owner): initializes metadata, mints supply to _owner and transfers ownership.
ERC20 totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
ERC20 balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender to `to` using safeSub/safeAdd.
ERC20 approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no zero-first check.
ERC20 transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves tokens spending msg.sender allowance via safeSub/safeAdd.
ERC20 allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): approves then calls spender.receiveApproval, giving control to an arbitrary contract.
Payable fallback function that always reverts, refusing plain Ether.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: external call to an arbitrary token contract transferring tokens to owner.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits and allowance bookkeeping.
Arithmetic a + b inside safeAdd; overflow guarded only by require(c >= a).
Arithmetic a - b inside safeSub; underflow guarded only by require(b <= a).
Arithmetic a * b inside safeMul with a division-based overflow guard.
Arithmetic a / b inside safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).
Arithmetic _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] computed in totalSupply().
Arithmetic totalSupply * 10**uint(decimals) in the constructor scaling the minted supply.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an arbitrary spender contract; state already written and control handed over, enabling reentrancy.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary, owner-supplied token contract.
require(msg.sender == owner) access-control check inside the onlyOwner modifier.
